page_subtitle: Your candidate profile - resume, LinkedIn, contacts, and matching rules. Used by both manual evaluation and automation.
extra_info_placeholder: Anything important that isn't covered by your resume or LinkedIn - extra projects, facts, metrics...
linkedin_text_placeholder: Paste your LinkedIn experience text here...
blockers_hint: Hard dealbreakers. If a posting matches any of these, it's scored 0 automatically — no exceptions. Write them in the first person, e.g. "I only want fully remote positions".
new_blocker_placeholder: e.g. I am looking only for fully remote work
factors_hint: Softer signals that push the score up or down, but never to zero. Weight 1 = minor nudge, 3 = major.
pregenerate_hint: Pre-run keyword extraction and the soft/medium proposals right after evaluation, instead of waiting until you open the tailoring page. Uses a bit more tokens per evaluated job, but the tailoring page opens already filled in. Only affects manual review - automated auto-apply flows already do this at a high enough score.
pregenerate_min_score_label: Minimum fit score to trigger pre-generation
auto_answer_hint: Applies to the manual Questions flow - when you paste a form, answers are drafted automatically for cover letter, summary, and general questions.
auto_answer_enabled_label: Automatically generate answers right after splitting a pasted form
salary_prefs_hint: How salaries are shown across the app - all figures are converted from the posting's original currency/period into this one.
blocks_hint: Blocks are the parts of the resume that tools read and rewrite one at a time. They do not have to cover the whole resume - headings like SUMMARY or SKILLS stay outside. Click rows to select them (Shift for a range), then create a block, add the selection to an existing one, or remove it from blocks.
blocks_mode_hint: Click to select, Shift for a range, double click for a whole block. Hover a block to see what it is.
blocks_name_required: Enter the company name for job blocks
toast_prefs_hint: Choose which popup notifications you want to see. Errors are always shown. Saved in this browser.
toast_cat_new_job: Automation: a new vacancy was found and scored
toast_cat_job_added: Evaluator: vacancy added to the dashboard
toast_cat_applied: Applied status changed (dashboard and vacancy page)
toast_cat_tailoring: Resume tailoring: title applied, block generated or reverted
